author: Komorebi P.
scope: Exact constant rational span of 533 retained formal generating functions. All 20 antidiagonal directions are independent modulo rational generating functions, using a cyclotomic annihilator on fixed-height slices for 18 of them and the balanced-binomial growth argument for two. Four square-array directions remain unresolved. The proof uses exact integer realization dimensions, modular rank witnesses, and the predecessor growth-tier argument.
